## Instalar / Install

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabelfaria/claudinho/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Ou baixe o `Claudinho-windows-x64.zip`, extraia e rode o `claudinho.exe`. / Or download the zip, extract it and run `claudinho.exe`.

Requer Windows 10/11 x64 e o Claude Code com uma assinatura Pro/Max. / Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and Claude Code with a Pro/Max plan.

Novidades: veja o [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gabelfaria/claudinho/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). / What's new: see the CHANGELOG.
